findings.risk: Neptune data and automated backups are stored unencrypted at rest, increasing exposure if underlying storage or snapshots are accessed without authorization.
findings.remediation: Set the aws_neptune_cluster.default attribute storage_encrypted = true and optionally specify kms_key_arn with a customer-managed KMS key.

findings.risk: Deleting the cluster can permanently remove data without a final recovery point, increasing the impact of accidental or malicious deletion.
findings.remediation: Change the aws_neptune_cluster.default attribute skip_final_snapshot = false and configure final_snapshot_identifier.

findings.risk: Disabling IAM authentication can force reliance on less centralized authentication controls and reduce the ability to enforce short-lived, identity-based access patterns.
findings.remediation: Set the aws_neptune_cluster.default attribute iam_database_authentication_enabled = true if IAM database authentication is required for your access model.
